artifacts.description: Severe smearing/black blur obscures and deforms the central subject’s torso and arms, creating an unnaturally blended silhouette where clothing/body boundaries should be clear (looks like a generation “melt”/masking failure). Spatial location: center of the image, running vertically from the mid-chest area down to the waist/hand area of the middle person and spilling into the lower-center foreground.

Hands/fingers appear partially lost in the same blur with unclear finger separation and inconsistent edges, suggesting malformed anatomy rather than motion blur. Spatial location: lower center, where the middle person’s hands should be.
T-shirt/hoodie lettering is not cleanly legible and looks inconsistent/garbled (typical AI text rendering issue). Spatial location: chest of the middle person (center).

Depth-of-field/softness is applied in a way that feels uneven: faces are sharp while adjacent body/clothing regions collapse into heavy, unnatural blur without a consistent optical explanation. Spatial location: primarily center and lower-center foreground compared to the relatively crisp faces in the upper-middle.

Subject is wearing what appears to be a space/astronaut-style suit/neck ring, but also a regular casual baseball cap; the combination is functionally inconsistent for real protective gear (helmet missing/doesn’t interface). Location: top-center on the woman’s head/neck area (cap and collar).

Neck collar/helmet-ring geometry looks malformed: asymmetric thickness and irregular inner rim contours that don’t follow a consistent manufactured shape. Location: center of image around the woman’s neck (teal/white collar).

Overly uniform, glossy ‘product-render’ look on the white suit with very clean edges and simplified fabric micro-texture compared to the rest of the scene. Location: center/lower-center on the woman’s torso and pants.

Hand/finger anatomy appears off: the supporting hand under the child’s thigh has ambiguous finger separation and unnatural curvature/length, suggesting fused or poorly defined digits. Location: lower-right center where the woman’s hand supports the boy’s leg.
Child’s lower-leg/ankle area blends oddly into the sock/shoe edge with smeared boundaries and inconsistent seam alignment. Location: lower center where the boy’s foot meets the girl’s hands.

Lighting/shadow consistency is slightly unnatural: faces appear evenly and cleanly lit while some clothing folds and background areas show harsher, more directional contrast, giving a composited feel. Location: overall, most noticeable on faces (upper center/right) vs. suit/background (center/right background).
Right hand shows muddled finger structure (digits appear fused/indistinct, with an unnatural knuckle/finger outline).','location':'mid-right of image, in front of her chest (raised arm/hand).
Left hand/fingers look malformed and partially merged into the shorts/hip area; edges lack clear finger separation.','location':'mid-left, near her left hip (lowered arm/hand).
Shoe/foot geometry is inconsistent: the rear/left shoe looks like an amorphous dark wedge with unclear sole and heel definition.','location':'lower center-left, trailing foot behind the front leg.

Background runners are excessively smeared/ill-defined in a way that doesn’t match a typical camera motion pattern for a sharp subject (faces/bodies become vague blobs rather than coherent motion blur).','location':'mid-right background and mid-left background behind the main runner.

Overly smooth, airbrushed skin and very uniform lighting/tonal transitions (especially on face and arms), giving a synthetic “stock-render” look.','location':'subject’s face (upper center) and arms/legs (center to lower center).

Teeth/mouth geometry is inconsistent: the visible teeth appear as a smooth, evenly spaced “block” with unnatural uniformity and unclear separation between individual teeth, not matching the lip/cheek deformation expected from the bite angle and pressure of the toothbrush head(s). This reads as a blended or synthesized dental region rather than a natural bite/teeth edge alignment (center of image, inside the open mouth).

Implausible brushing action: the subject appears to be biting down on a toothbrush head while another toothbrush is also positioned across/into the mouth area at the same time, creating an awkward, functionally odd configuration for actually brushing (lower center; two toothbrush heads converging at the mouth).

Toothbrush interaction/occlusion looks off: the bristles and plastic edges don’t convincingly compress against the lips/teeth; contact points look ‘hovered’ or too clean with minimal deformation, suggesting imperfect object-to-face compositing (at the mouth line where both toothbrush heads meet the teeth/lip area).

Hand/finger rendering irregularities: fingertips and nail/skin transitions look slightly waxy/smudged with some ambiguous edge definition, typical of generative smoothing, especially on the hand at the right edge holding the blue-handled brush (right side, lower-right quadrant).

Overly cinematic, shallow-depth-of-field look with very uniform skin detail and microtexture that feels ‘airbrushed’/CG-like compared to the rest of the scene’s realism (face overall, especially cheeks/forehead in the upper-center).

Ear anatomy looks simplified/warped: the outer rim and inner folds are under-defined and blend unnaturally into the side of the head/hairline, with a slightly “melted” contour rather than crisp cartilage detail typical in photos at this resolution/sharpness level (right side of face, mid-right edge).

Stethoscope tubing/hardware has inconsistent geometry: the left loop and the lower connection area show odd kinks/joins and an unclear attachment point where the metal/plastic transitions, giving a subtly malformed, non-manufactured look (lower-left chest area, around the stethoscope’s lower bend/connector).

Wardrobe/prop styling feels like a stock “doctor” composite: perfectly clean lab coat with stethoscope and an unusually pristine, uniform texture shirt with a slightly ambiguous collar/placket structure—reads more like a generic AI/stock archetype than a candid clinical portrait (center torso: collar, buttons/placket, and coat lapels).

Skin appears overly smooth with uniform pore detail and cosmetically even specular highlights, producing a ‘plastic/airbrushed’ finish inconsistent with the otherwise sharp, high-contrast portrait lighting (entire face, especially cheeks and forehead).

Background bokeh and lighting look algorithmically uniform: repeated soft rectangular ceiling lights and corridor blur appear too clean/regular, with a rendered “studio-like” depth-of-field feel rather than natural optical imperfections (upper background and corridor behind subject).
